trades.name: Long demand around June low 28228 (28195-28235)
trades.quote: There is some demand in and around the June low 28228. It ranges roughly 195-235 and we know the entire 200-240 range has been important at times. This is where I would look to get long if buyers are to protect Friday’s low and make a run for Friday’s excess. I do believe this trade can be more difficult to manage depending on how Sunday opens. Because of that I can’t rate it better than a B/B+ but if buyers are going to break this out it comes from here (or frankly from Friday’s AH low which would be annoying if we get a gap up and go directly from there).
